fallbacks.stateMatrixCopy: {{title}} must show how critical states behave across its actual surfaces and roles.
dataPermissions: Every screen declares owner, source, freshness, sync behavior, and stale-data copy.
Permission checks are visible before irreversible actions.
Audit events are generated for roles, drivers, vehicles, cards, limits, and finance changes when relevant.
Sensitive information has privacy, masking, export, and retention rules.

Card hero with limits.copy: Shows card readiness, available amount, limit context, and blocked-state explanation before any action.

Recent movement feed.copy: Keeps recent authorizations scannable with status, merchant, amount, and route to detail.

Nearby station shortcut.copy: Starts station discovery while preserving location permission and fallback-list behavior.

Support and dispute path.copy: Gives drivers a clear recovery route for blocked cards, suspicious movements, or failed payments.

processDetails.Driver Onboarding Mobile: Proves identity, consent, first-use guidance, and recovery before the driver reaches card controls.
processDetails.Mobile Card Overview: Turns card readiness, limit context, blocked states, and recent movements into the first useful screen.
processDetails.Routes and Nearby Stations Mobile: Connects station discovery to location permission, fallback list, selected station, and route handoff.

Driver Mobile App.standard: This template is the driver entry point: it must connect authentication, card readiness, nearby stations, recent activity, and support without making the driver hunt across separate screens.
Driver Mobile App.screenSystem: The screen system prioritizes first-use readiness, then repeated driver actions, then recovery. Modules should behave like one mobile product surface rather than disconnected shortcuts.
Driver Mobile App.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows the driver's daily jobs: start, control card, find fuel, and recover through support.
Driver Mobile App.primary: Driver opens the app at a station and needs to know if the card is ready, where to fuel, and what to do if something fails.
qualityGates: Card readiness, route access, and support recovery are visible on first load.
Location denial keeps route and station discovery usable.
Biometric fallback preserves trust copy and recovery.

Executive KPI band.copy: Summarizes health, spend, risk, and trend signals with clear threshold ownership.

Exception inbox.copy: Prioritizes operational exceptions with owner, severity, age, and next action.

Fleet activity timeline.copy: Shows recent driver, vehicle, fuel, maintenance, and support events in accountable sequence.

Cost center filter set.copy: Preserves fleet scope, saved views, and reset behavior across dashboard modules.

processDetails.Topbar: Provides global actions, search entry, identity, and workspace affordances without redefining button, input, or avatar behavior.
processDetails.Sidebar: Provides desktop product navigation, hierarchy, active state, and section persistence without owning module content.
processDetails.Fleet Dashboard Overview: Sets the shared dashboard shell, filter memory, KPI hierarchy, and exception routing.
processDetails.Fuel Dashboard: Tracks spend, authorization anomalies, station usage, and drill-down evidence for fuel operations.
processDetails.Roles and Permissions: Controls who can see, change, approve, and audit fleet-management actions.

Fleet Manager Desktop.standard: This template is the manager operating console: it must preserve context while moving from health scan to exception triage to accountable follow-up.
Fleet Manager Desktop.screenSystem: The screen system is built around overview, exception handling, activity history, and scope controls so managers can move without losing operational context.
Fleet Manager Desktop.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows fleet-management responsibility: overview first, then operational domains, then configuration.
Fleet Manager Desktop.primary: Fleet manager scans operational health, isolates exceptions, and assigns follow-up without leaving the dashboard.
qualityGates: Exceptions keep owner, severity, and recovery route.
Permission scope changes visible data and actions.

Card status block.copy: Keeps status, limit, risk, and usable balance visible before card-level actions.

Quick actions.copy: Groups frequent controls while preserving confirmation, disabled reasons, and support routing.

Movement receipt detail.copy: Explains a movement with merchant, amount, authorization, timestamp, card, and support evidence.

Dispute entry point.copy: Starts recovery with eligibility, required evidence, expected timing, and audit trail.

processDetails.Mobile Card Overview: Keeps status, limit, movement summary, blocked states, and next useful action visible.
processDetails.Mobile Card Detail and Quick Actions: Lets drivers control a card while preserving confirmation, disabled reasons, and support handoff.
processDetails.Mobile Movement Detail: Turns each movement into receipt-like evidence with recovery, dispute, and audit context.

Driver Card Wallet.standard: This template is the card-control workspace: it must keep status, limits, movements, quick actions, and dispute recovery in one accountable system.
Driver Card Wallet.screenSystem: The screen system separates card state, actions, movement evidence, and support entry so each module can fail or recover without hiding the card context.
Driver Card Wallet.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows the wallet mental model: card first, movements second, limits third, help always available.
Driver Card Wallet.primary: Driver needs fast control over a payment card while understanding risk, limits, support, and movement history.
qualityGates: Card status and limits remain visible before quick actions.
Movement detail includes merchant, amount, authorization, and support route.
Blocked or risky states explain the next safe action.

Map with station pins.copy: Shows nearby stations with permission, loading, cluster, and selected-pin states.

Fallback station list.copy: Keeps station discovery usable when map, GPS, or network context is unavailable.

Station services panel.copy: Compares service availability, distance, fuel types, schedule, and restrictions.

Route handoff.copy: Transfers station context to navigation while preserving ETA, destination, and recovery copy.

processDetails.Routes and Nearby Stations Mobile: Keeps map, list, permissions, distance, and selected station in the same decision path.
processDetails.Station Detail and Route Guidance: Moves from station comparison to external navigation with ETA, service restrictions, and recovery.

Routes and Stations.standard: This template is the station-discovery workspace: map, list, station detail, and route handoff must stay equivalent, especially when location or network context fails.
Routes and Stations.screenSystem: The screen system keeps map and list as parallel paths, with station detail and navigation handoff as explicit decisions.
Routes and Stations.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows travel intent: discover, compare, inspect, and route.
Routes and Stations.primary: Driver searches nearby stations, compares useful station information, and starts navigation with graceful location fallback.
qualityGates: Map and list remain equivalent paths.
Location denial shows fallback list and manual station search.
Route handoff preserves station context and recovery copy.

Dashboard switcher.copy: Moves between operational domains without losing scope, period, or comparison context.

Shared filter bar.copy: Controls fleet segment, time range, cost center, and saved views across dashboards.

Domain KPI stack.copy: Pairs each KPI with definition, threshold, trend, and drill-in responsibility.

Drill-down table.copy: Supports sorting, filtering, density, export, keyboard use, and audit-ready row detail.

Fleet Dashboard Suite.screenSystem: The screen system coordinates dashboard switching, shared filters, KPI stacks, and drill-down tables across operational domains.
Fleet Dashboard Suite.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows domain accountability: overview, fuel, maintenance, EV, toll, fleet, and finance.
Fleet Dashboard Suite.primary: Fleet team moves across seven operational dashboards while preserving filters, context, thresholds, and accountability.
qualityGates: Shared filters carry across all dashboards.

Permission matrix.copy: Shows role capabilities, dependencies, approval needs, and risky changes before save.

Driver lifecycle table.copy: Manages driver creation, suspension, recovery, ownership, and evidence states.

Vehicle lifecycle table.copy: Manages vehicle status, assignment, eligibility, documents, and operational blockers.
